text: $H is Here: Introducing the First-Ever Fairdrop Humans Developers Enterprises The Protocol Resources About Join Mainnet Select Language English English $H is Here: Introducing the First-Ever Fairdrop $H is Here: Introducing the First-Ever Fairdrop $H is Here: Introducing the First-Ever Fairdrop Humanity Protocol is the backbone of the next-generation internet. It’s a decentralized identity system that lets anyone prove they’re human and verify their identity without ever revealing personal data. Leveraging zero-knowledge cryptography and privacy-preserving biometrics, users’ Human IDs serve as their passports across Web3 and beyond. From powering bot-proof Fairdrops to enabling seamless payments at real-world events, Humanity Protocol is becoming one of the most valuable and widely applicable human-centric blockchains in existence, built not just for crypto-natives, but for everyone. At the core of this ecosystem is the $H token, launching on major exchanges on June 25, 2025. The first drop of $H will also represent the very first Fairdrop in Web3, marking a major milestone not just for Humanity Protocol but for the entire Web3 industry. What is $H? $H is Humanity Protocol’s native token which fuels the entire network, incentivizing zkProofers, identity validators, and builders who are laying the foundation for a more equitable digital world and powering these transactions globally. When you perform any action on Humanity Protocol, from linking your education credentials to your Human ID to proving that you hold a ticket at an event, there are numerous operations firing off globally to ensure that your activities are secure, untampered, and legitimate. $H is the medium of exchange that makes this all possible. It rewards the decentralized network of validators who uphold the system’s integrity, and it gives developers the fuel they need to build human-first applications on the chain. Every scan, every attestation, every verified interaction runs on $H. As adoption grows as a trusted identity solution across Web3 and IRL, $H will continue to power the chain’s economy. What is a Fairdrop? Airdrops were supposed to reward early users and grow strong communities. But in practice, they’ve been hijacked by bots, Sybils, and wallet farmers who game the system and dump tokens without ever engaging. The practice might have worked in the past, but is now of little value to newer Web3 projects that are spending their user acquisition costs on bots. Humanity Protocol is fixing this broken system with the launch of the world’s first Fairdrop, a new standard where real, verified humans are finally the ones who benefit. Fairdrops is a tool built by Humanity that will allow builders of other blockchain organizations to verify genuine users and distinguish them from bots. Real humans are determined in a number of ways. This is usually a mix of how many social credentials they’ve linked to their Human ID, whether they’ve scanned their palm using the app or at any of the global roll out events, and whether they contribute within the communities as real humans. These vectors will change and adapt as bots continue to get more sophisticated. This particular Fairdrop begins by recognizing the people who’ve helped build this community from the ground up: real users, Kaito stakers, our Discord community, and builders are among those who stand to receive their drop of $H in the coming week. These recipients aren’t random wallets. They’re real individuals, proven on-chain. And because only real humans can participate, the Fairdrop ensures tokens land in the hands of people who actually matter. In this Fairdrop, you have until 9AM UTC on 24 June 2025 to claim your $H. Here’s how you can make your claim: 1. Visit https://testnet.humanity.org/ 2. Log into your Humanity account 3. Click on “Check eligibility” 4. You’ll see a pop-up window prompting you to check your eligibility here. Click on “Check eligibility” again and you’ll see the amount of $H you were allocated. 5. From here, click “Connect your wallet” and follow the onscreen instructions to connect the wallet in which you wish to receive your airdrop. 6. On Wednesday, 25th June 2025 at 9AM UTC, go to fairdrops.com to claim your tokens, which will be paid into the wallet you register today. 7. Ensure the wallet you choose has enough funds to cover any gas fees. This is the first of many Fairdrops. You can also earn $H by contributing in other areas. The chart below outlines token allocations for the full supply of 10B $H. Why $H Stakers Win Big Once they’ve received their fairdrop, they’ll be able to begin staking their $H to contribute to securing the network. Staking $H doesn’t just support the protocol, it unlocks a powerful advantage. Every project that partners with Humanity Protocol to run their own Fairdrop will distribute tokens only to verified humans. And among the first to receive those airdrops will be $H stakers. By staking, you’re signaling that you’re a high-value user in a network of real humans. That makes you top priority for token distributions, not just from Humanity Protocol, but from every ecosystem that launches Fairdrops through us. Staking $H is your ticket to a portfolio of upcoming airdrops from quality projects that want real users, not bots. This Is Just the Beginning The Fairdrop is a new model for how value should move on-chain: human-first, trust-based, and bot-proof. Humanity Protocol is leading the charge but we’re not doing it alone. We’re building a new standard in collaboration with projects that care about distributing tokens fairly and building genuine communities. If you believe in a more fair, more human Web3, this is your chance to be part of the first chapter. Verify once, stake $H, and claim your place at the front of the line.
